captions: Your banking app remembers every one.
Coffee. Lunch. A delivery. Another coffee.
Each time, you tap without thinking.
The man outside the shop? You walk past.
“Next time,” you tell yourself. Every time.
This evening, at the mosque door, a small box.
You slip in the price of one coffee.
No one sees it. Allah sees it.
Your wallet feels lighter. Your heart, too.

verses.text: “And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion.”

hook.text: 23 coffees this month. Not one coin in sadaqa.
